verdict.rationale: On-demand triggering is well documented: you can comment `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`, tag the bot in PR comments, or request reviews through the MCP server. Users can also choose which repositories cubic reviews, and cubic.yaml governs "AI review behavior" and ignore patterns. By default cubic auto-reviews every new PR, and the evidence never shows how to suppress that for drafts, branches or labels. missing for 10: skipping draft PRs, branch-based filtering, label-based filtering, documented opt-out of automatic reviews, independent corroboration.
